summary: Vercel's TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents with one API across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other model providers.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: The AI SDK is a provider-agnostic TypeScript toolkit for AI-powered apps and agents. One API generates text, structured data and tool-using agents with any supported model, and the AI SDK UI hooks help build chat and generative interfaces in frameworks such as Next.js, React and Svelte.
sixtySeconds.problem: Every model provider has its own SDK and streaming format. The AI SDK gives one interface so you can switch models without rewriting your app.
whoFor: Teams building chat UIs in Next.js or React
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a unified provider API, strong UI integration and an agent class that loops over tool calls for you.
requirements: A model provider: Vercel AI Gateway or a provider's own package

overview: Install with npm install ai. By default it routes through the Vercel AI Gateway, so you can pass a model string like anthropic/... or openai/.... Or install provider packages such as @ai-sdk/openai, @ai-sdk/anthropic or @ai-sdk/google to connect directly.
Use generateText for text, structured output helpers for typed data, and ToolLoopAgent for agents that call tools. UI hooks come from framework packages such as @ai-sdk/react.
Coding agents can add the AI SDK skill with npx skills add vercel/ai. It is Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: Gateway or provider usage costs money
